GLOSSARY.GLOSSARY_DESC: Below is a brief explanation of the key terms used in your Horoscope and what they signify.
GLOSSARY.TITHI_DESC: The lunar day, calculated by the distance between the Sun and Moon. It governs your emotional and mental state.
GLOSSARY.VARA_DESC: The solar day of the week, ruled by a specific planet. It determines the underlying energy and vitality of your birth day.
GLOSSARY.NAKSHATRA_DESC: The constellation the Moon was positioned in at the time of your birth. It shapes your core personality, mind, and emotional patterns.
GLOSSARY.YOGA_DESC: Formed by the combined longitude of the Sun and Moon. It indicates your overall prosperity, luck, and natural disposition.
GLOSSARY.KARANA_DESC: Half of a Tithi. It represents your actions, practical efforts, and professional success in life.
GLOSSARY.LAGNA_DESC: The zodiac sign rising on the eastern horizon at the exact time of your birth. It represents your physical body, outward behavior, and life path.
GLOSSARY.RASI_DESC: The zodiac sign where the Moon was placed at your birth. It represents your inner mind, emotions, and intuition.

HOW_TO_READ.TITLE: How to Read Your Horoscope
HOW_TO_READ.SUBTITLE: A beginner's guide to understanding your Vedic Astrology report.
HOW_TO_READ.SECTION1_DESC: The square chart represents the sky at your exact time of birth. In the South Indian style, the 12 boxes (houses) are always fixed. The top-left box is Pisces (Meenam), and the signs go clockwise. 'Lagna' (Ascendant) is your starting point—this is the 1st House, representing 'You'.
HOW_TO_READ.SECTION2_DESC: Counting clockwise from your Lagna, each house rules a part of life. 1st: Self, 2nd: Wealth, 4th: Mother/Home, 5th: Children, 7th: Marriage, 9th: Luck/Father, 10th: Career, 11th: Gains.
HOW_TO_READ.SECTION3_DESC: The planets (Grahas) move through these signs. Their placement in a specific sign and house shapes your life's events. Benefic planets (Jupiter, Venus) bring ease, while Malefic planets (Saturn, Mars) bring challenges and growth.
HOW_TO_READ.SECTION4_DESC: Vedic astrology uses Vimshottari Dasha, a 120-year cycle of planetary periods. Your life is divided into phases ruled by different planets. The planet ruling your current phase strongly influences your current life events.

HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.TITLE: How to Read Your Matching Report
HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.SUBTITLE: A beginner's guide to understanding Vedic marriage compatibility.
HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.SECTION1_DESC: This North Indian system evaluates 8 parameters (Varna, Vashya, Tara, Yoni, Graha Maitri, Gana, Bhakoot, Nadi). A score of 18 or above out of 36 is generally considered acceptable. Higher scores indicate better natural harmony.
HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.SECTION2_DESC: This South Indian system checks 10 vital parameters. Some poruthams are critical—for instance, Rajju failure (longevity issues) or Vedha failure (severe obstacles) are often considered strict dealbreakers, regardless of the total score.
HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.SECTION3_DESC: When Mars is placed in specific challenging houses, it causes Manglik Dosha, which can cause friction in marriage. However, if both partners have a similar Dosha intensity, the effects are mutually neutralized or cancelled out.
HOW_TO_READ_MATCHING.SECTION4_DESC: This is the process of balancing malefic planetary points. The harsh points generated by Saturn, Mars, Rahu, Ketu, and the Sun in the boy's chart must not significantly exceed the points in the girl's chart for a peaceful life.
